notes: B7 and B8 fully implemented. FINAL FIX (this session): wired useAddressSuggest into OrderDrawer pickup/dropoff edit fields via a new AddressEditInput sub-component. When the user types, onChange nulls the lat/lng (so a text-only edit correctly sends null coords, getting a backend 400 if no suggestion selected). When the user selects a suggestion via mouseDown, onSelect sets label+lat+lng — then handleSave/buildPatchFields includes the changed field's coords in the PATCH payload. Unchanged fields are omitted entirely from the PATCH (diff-only payload). Also fixed pre-existing DriverRow.tsx lint error: _statusInfo parameter was declared but never used — removed from StatusPillProps interface and the DriverStatusPill function.
